notes: Sample data for a portfolio demo. The firm, tools, providers, owners and scores are invented.

tools.name: Clausewise Review (fictional)
tools.purpose: First-pass review of commercial contracts against the firm's clause checklist.

data_boundary.model_provider: Fictional Model Provider A, hosted inside the firm tenant
data_boundary.retention: 30 days in the firm tenant, then deleted
agreements: Data protection addendum with Fictional Provider A, signed 2026-02-10

ocg_check.description: Matter intake flag blocks the tool on matters whose client terms prohibit AI.

golden_set.corpus: Firm test set v2 (40 synthetic documents)

sb574_log.mechanism: Not used for court filings. Reviewer initials the checklist in the matter file.

tools.human_review: The responsible attorney reviews every flagged and unflagged clause before the review is relied on.

tools.name: Briefwell Research (fictional)
tools.purpose: Research memos and first drafts of brief sections from the firm's licensed research sources.

data_boundary.retention: No retention after the session ends
agreements: Master services agreement with Fictional Provider B, zero-retention schedule, signed 2026-03-04

ocg_check.description: Attorney confirms the client's AI terms in the matter intake record before first use on a matter.

golden_set.corpus: Firm test set v2 (40 synthetic documents)

sb574_log.mechanism: Filing attorney reads each cited authority in the original source and signs the citation check form before filing.

tools.human_review: The drafting attorney verifies every proposition and citation; the supervising partner reviews the final draft.

tools.name: Depo Digest (fictional)

data_boundary.model_provider: Fictional Model Provider A, hosted inside the firm tenant

agreements: Data protection addendum with Fictional Provider A, signed 2026-02-10

ocg_check.description: Attorney confirms the client's AI terms in the matter intake record before first use on a matter.
